subject: Executive demo — narrow windows for CIO/VP attendance
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@calyxhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Executive demo — narrow windows for CIO/VP attendance

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the great discovery call last week. Our CIO, Ramon Ortega, and VP of Engineering, Sandra Lee, are interested in a concise executive walkthrough of Redwood focusing on reliability and latency for our inference-heavy pipelines. They have very limited availability next week (only two small windows) so I wanted to share those now:

- Tue, Jun 13, 2028 — 3:00–3:45 PM ET
- Wed, Jun 14, 2028 — 11:30–12:15 PM ET

We'd like a 30–40 minute session with: 15–20 minutes demo (key metrics + failover) and 10–15 minutes for Q&A. Can you confirm if you have an exec-level presenter (CTO/VP/Head of Product) who can join for the full slot?

I can also invite procurement by separate email if you need contract / procurement presence.

Attached a short internal note on our scope for context.

Best,
Elena Park
Senior Program Manager — Platform Programs
Calyx Health

Attachment: Calyx-sponsor-prep-notes.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 14:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo — narrow windows for CIO/VP attendance

Hi Elena — thanks for the windows and the prep notes. Both slots are doable in principle; I need to confirm exec coverage. Quick notes:

- We recommend 35 minutes total to leave room for the CIO's questions on SLA/retention (we'll keep the demo tight).
- We can have Vivek attend as our technical exec to speak to latency/kv-cache behaviors and fallback routing. If Ramon wants broad product strategy, Marissa can cover that.

Vivek — can you commit to either Tue 3:00–3:45 PM ET or Wed 11:30–12:15 PM ET? If both, we can hold Tuesday and free the other if needed. Also flag if you want a 15-minute dry run with their team.

Elena — attaching a draft 1–page agenda and a short run of show. If you confirm a day, we'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and an optional pre-read.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

On Tue, Jun 5, 2028 at 2:04 PM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vivek — can you commit to either Tue 3:00–3:45 PM ET or Wed 11:30–12:15 PM ET?

I can cover both in principle, but prefer Tue 3pm ET. Tuesday works best for me because I have lighter travel that afternoon. I'll plan to cover:

- 7–10 minute technical primer on how we guarantee tail-latency at scale
- 8–10 minute demo showing failover to cheaper quantized model and routing policy fallback
- Q&A on ops and integration (if Ramon asks for logs / audit details, I'll loop in SRE after)

If you'd like a 15-minute dry run, I can do Mon Jun 12 at 4:00 PM ET — otherwise I'll rely on the run of show in the agenda.

Vivek
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena.park@calyxhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Executive demo — narrow windows for CIO/VP attendance

Thanks — Tue, Jun 13 at 3:00 PM ET works for Ramon and Sandra. Please send invite and any dial-in details. Procurement: looping you in to coordinate the next steps if we move toward procurement discussion after the demo.

A couple of asks for the session:
- Can you include one slide that briefly states Redwood's data residency and retention controls (Ramon likes explicit bullet points)?
- If possible, avoid deep engineering code samples in the exec portion; we can surface those in a follow-up with engineering.

We'll plan for 35 minutes (20 min demo + 15 min Q&A). Looking forward to it.

Best,
Elena
